name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Materialize radio buttons, filled or with-gap, as an accessible radio group with arrow-key navigation.
improvements: Built on Radix RadioGroup: one tab stop, arrow keys move and select, and the group is exposed as role=radiogroup.
Controlled or uncontrolled value; name and required work in native forms.
Visible focus halo for keyboard users.
The with-gap style is a prop on the group (or per item) instead of a class on every input.
Transitions are turned off when the user prefers reduced motion; colors follow dark mode.
